keySentence: Buck was taken from comfort and thrown into a brutal world.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Buck's body grew stronger. His mind changed too. Change can make us stronger. Buck was taken from comfort and thrown into a brutal world.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Buck's soft paws became hard, and his thin fur grew thick and warm. But the biggest change was happening inside Buck's mind. He used to depend on people for everything he needed. Now he was learning to take care of himself completely. Buck was taken from comfort and thrown into a brutal world. Sometimes big changes in life actually make us stronger than before.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: After just a short time in Alaska, Buck had undergone a remarkable physical transformation. His once-soft paws had hardened like leather, and his coat grew dense enough to withstand the bitter cold. More importantly, his mind was adapting in ways he could never have imagined back in California. The instincts of his wild ancestors were slowly awakening deep within his consciousness. Buck was taken from comfort and thrown into a brutal world. However, these changes were not just about survival in the present moment. Because Buck was being stripped of his comfortable domesticated life, his true nature was emerging. He was discovering that sometimes losing everything you know is the beginning of finding who you truly are.
facts.Word cards: comfort = 편안함 / brutal = 잔인한 / adapt = 적응하다 / thrown into = 던져졌다
